title: Adventure Notes
description: A personal adventure journal — create notes, save coordinates, track your deaths, and share your journal with other players.
body:
# 📖 Adventure Notes

Your personal adventure journal for Minecraft. Never forget where you built your base, found diamonds, or died again.

---

## ✨ Features

### 📝 Notes
Create unlimited notes with titles, text, and categories. Write down anything — base locations, plans, observations, coordinates of interesting places.

### 🏷️ Categories
Organize your notes with 8 color-coded categories:
- **General** — for anything
- **Base** — your builds and homes
- **Mines** — ore locations and caves
- **Village** — trading posts and villages
- **Nether** — nether locations
- **End** — end dimension notes
- **Danger** — dangerous areas
- **To-Do** — your task list

### 📍 Coordinates
Attach your current XYZ position and dimension to any note. Never lose a location again.

### 💀 Death Tracking
Every death is automatically recorded with coordinates, dimension, time, and cause. Open the death log anytime with a hotkey.

### 📕 Sealed Journal
Create a read-only copy of your journal and give it to another player. They can read all your notes but cannot edit them. The sealed journal glows with enchantment effect.

### ✏️ View & Edit Modes
Switch between View mode (read-only) and Edit mode. No accidental edits.

### 📋 Full Text Editing
- Select text with Shift+Arrows
- Select all with Ctrl+A
- Copy/Paste/Cut with Ctrl+C/V/X
- Scrollable text area with draggable scrollbar

### ⌨️ Hotkeys
- **J** — Open journal (requires item in inventory)
- **O** — Open death log
- **Right-click** — Open journal from hand
- **Shift+Right-click** — Create sealed copy

### 💾 Persistent Storage
All notes are saved per-player in the world data. Your notes survive death, relog, and server restart.

### 🌐 Multiplayer Ready
Full client-server synchronization. Works in singleplayer and on dedicated servers.

---

## 📦 How to Use

1. Craft or grab an **Adventure Notes** item
2. Right-click to open your journal
3. Press **New** to create your first note
4. Click **View** to switch to **Editing** mode
5. Write your title and text
6. Choose a category, attach coordinates if needed
7. Press **Save**
8. Done! Your note is stored forever.

---

## 📋 Requirements

- Minecraft **1.20.1**
- Forge **47.x**
- Java **17**

---

## 🌍 Languages

- English
- Russian
